get_baseline_evaluation: get a compute_metrics function for evaluating baseline model predictions using a tokenizer and generator
postprocess_text: postprocess predicted and label text by stripping special tokens and splitting on answer delimiters
compute_metrics: compute exact match and F1 scores on decoded predictions with per-type and per-relation breakdowns
average_score: compute the average of a scoring function across all prediction-label pairs in the dataset
breakdown_score: compute a scoring function broken down by metadata field like question type or relation
